svg.text: Project 1: Jenkins + Docker CI/CD on my home lab
Follow the numbers ① → ⑧. The coloured circle on each step shows which module taught it (legend at the bottom).
keep this window open = tunnel open
Ubuntu 26.04 · user harsh-lab · reached over SSH
job: module5-pipeline · runs as Linux user "jenkins" · Java 21
③ Jenkins asks GitHub every ~2 min:
④ new commit → Jenkins clones the repo
port 8082 is NOT open to the network
Server prep: UFW firewall, ports, image vs container
Jenkins: Java 21, service, SSH tunnel, first job
Docker: Tomcat, Dockerfile, build context, run
Pipeline: Jenkinsfile stages, docker group, redeploy
Automation: Poll SCM, git push = auto deploy
Black circles = the order things happen (① → ⑧)
You write a recipe (code) on your Mac and put it
in the shared recipe book (GitHub). The kitchen
manager (Jenkins) checks the book, the mixer (Maven)
bakes a cake (.war), it goes in a lunchbox (image), is
served (container), and you eat via a secret hallway (tunnel).
